name: @shtora/s3poly
description: Streaming XChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption and S3-compatible upload helpers using libsodium secretstream.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --external @aws-sdk/client-s3 --external @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner && bun x tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.test:watch: bunx vitest src/crypto.test.ts src/format.test.ts src/index.test.ts src/s3.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: bunx vitest run --coverage src/crypto.test.ts src/format.test.ts src/index.test.ts src/s3.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: bunx vitest run src/crypto.test.ts src/format.test.ts src/index.test.ts src/s3.test.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test
